sections.title: Cloud security & IAM
sections.subtitle: Clear architecture. Controlled access. Stronger cloud foundations.

backgroundImage.alt: Cloud security and identity access management

sections.heading: Secure the connections that run your cloud
sections.body:
Cloud security depends on how systems connect, how access is granted and how controls are maintained. We help you review architecture across networks, firewalls and identity and access management (IAM), with cloud security and GRC considered together.

Understand the current environment, identify priorities and align security decisions with the way your organisation operates. Controls, IAM and regulation become part of the architecture conversation, not an afterthought.

sections.heading: Architecture and access, reviewed together
sections.description: Architecture review: Network, firewall & IAM. Cloud security & GRC: Controls, IAM & regulation.

cards.title: Cloud architecture
cards.description: Review how cloud services and workloads connect. Identify security boundaries and the dependencies that need closer attention.

cards.title: Network controls
cards.description: Assess network and firewall design against intended access paths, with clear ownership of configuration and change.

cards.title: Identity & access
cards.description: Review roles, permissions and access lifecycles. Align IAM decisions with the people and services that need access.

cards.title: Cloud GRC
cards.description: Connect controls and IAM with governance, risk and regulatory requirements. Identify the evidence needed to support ongoing review.

sections.title: Build security into your cloud architecture
sections.description: Start with the access and control decisions that matter.

sections.heading: A practical review, an actionable direction
sections.description: Make the current state visible before deciding which changes to make. Bring architecture, operations and risk owners into the same review.

items.title: Map the environment
items.description: Understand workloads, network paths, firewall policies and identity dependencies. Establish the scope and the purpose of each control.

items.title: Review architecture and IAM
items.description: Compare the intended design with current configuration and permissions. Record gaps in access boundaries, responsibilities and control coverage.

items.title: Agree the priorities
items.description: Work with stakeholders to prioritise changes by risk and delivery impact. Define owners and the evidence needed to verify remediation.

items.title: Keep controls current
items.description: Review access and configuration as services change. Connect operational checks with the organisation's governance and compliance activities.
